claims.statement: Targets INR8,000 crore revenue for FY25 and INR9,500 crore for FY26
Capex per new company-owned store is INR1.5-1.75 crore
Plans 5-6 new stores in Q3-Q4 FY25 and 10 stores in FY26, all company-owned in Maharashtra
Revenue per store target INR120-130 crore at maturity; new stores target INR60-65 crore in first year
Targets 10-12% gross margin in next 2-3 quarters via higher studded mix, lower finance cost, IIBX sourcing, and karigar cost negotiation
9 stores launched in Q3 FY25 achieving 75% of FY26 target of 12 stores
Remaining stores to be launched by Q4 FY25
Gold hedging through GML was 83.6% hedged by December 24 and currently fully hedged
Q4 FY25 expected to maintain Q3 profitability momentum with neutral gold price impact due to hedging
Plan to add 25 stores in FY26: 8 COCO PNG stores, 7-8 franchisee PNG stores, ~10 litestyle stores (half COCO/half FOCO), plus 1-2 US stores
Reached 50 stores in January 2025, targeting 53 stores by March 2025 end (3 more in March)
Q3 FY25 consolidated EBITDA margin 5.3% (+50 bps YoY), PAT margin 3.5% (+60 bps YoY)
9 new Navaratri stores contributed INR 240 cr revenue in Q3 FY25; at 24% of breakeven target (INR 1,010 cr)
13 stores launched by FY25 against plan of 12 stores by FY26
FY26 revenue growth target 25-30% on FY25 base of Rs 7,700 crore
FY26 PAT margin guidance 2.75-3.25% at consolidated level
FY26 retail EBITDA margin target 7-8% with 30-35% topline growth
FY26 volume growth target 8-11%
LiteStyle store capex including stock not exceeding Rs 8-9 crore per store
Plan to add 22-25 stores in FY26: 12-13 PNG full-fledged and 12-13 LiteStyle; 50% franchisee, 50% company-owned
FY26 store opening timeline: Q1 2-3 LiteStyle, Q2 6-7 PNG stores plus UP expansion and Dadar flagship, Q3-Q4 4-5 each quarter
Target ~10 stores outside Maharashtra in FY26 (3 Goa, 5-6 UP, possibly Bihar)
Q4 FY25 retail EBITDA margin 7.9%, PAT margin 4.2%; consolidated EBITDA margin 6.9% (+90 bps), PAT margin 3.9% (+30 bps)
FY25 consolidated EBITDA margin 4.8% (+20 bps), PAT margin 2.8% (+30 bps)
Store count increased to 55 as of 30 June 2025 (28 COCO, 13 FOCO, 11 franchise)
Strategic roadmap includes pan-India scaling, LiteStyle expansion, digital growth, and management team building
FY26 revenue guidance Rs 9,000-9,500 crore and PAT margin 3.5-4%
FY26 store addition target 20-23 stores (later updated to 23-25)
FY26 expansion funded 50% internal accruals, Rs 300-400 crore infusion needed, Rs 140 crore bank sanctions
PNG store capex ~Rs 50 crore, LiteStyle store capex ~Rs 10 crore, franchise zero capex
Target 100+ stores by March 2028, ~80 stores by FY26 end, 20-25 stores/year from internal accruals
Q2 FY26 store openings: Nashik (PNG), Jalgaon, Indore, Kolhapur, Lucknow, Kanpur, Dadar flagship; 4 LiteStyle shop-in-shops
Q1 FY26 gross margin 13.2% (up from 8.3% YoY), EBITDA margin 7.2% (+320bps), PAT margin 4% (+190bps)
Gross margin 13% sustainable driven by studded mix (33% margin), old gold procurement (3% spread), diamond cost advantage
Franchise gross margin 3% (2.5% sale margin + 0.5% royalty), no inventory on company books
Akshaya Tritiya single-day sales Rs 1,395.3 crore (+35.1% YoY), highest ever
Net cash used in investing activities for H1 FY26 was INR 1,624.4 million (consolidated)
Target 76-78 stores by March 2026 and 150 stores by March 2028
Plan to add 30-35 stores over next two years after FY26
H2 FY26 store additions of 13-15 stores, mix of PNG and LiteStyle, COCO and FOCO
EBITDA margin expected to sustain at 5.5-6% for full year FY26
Marketing spend capped at 1.25-1.5% of revenue for full year
Studded jewellery ratio target 12-13% in next two years
Plan to add one international store per year, starting with North America West Coast
Q2 FY26 gross margin 11.9% (+510 bps YoY), EBITDA margin 6.6% (+327 bps YoY), net margin 3.6% (+190 bps YoY)
Retail segment EBITDA margin 9.1%, PAT margin 5.1% in Q2 FY26
Gross margin improvement expected in Q3 FY26 vs Q2 due to festive season
Gold schemes: Golden Gain 53 kg, Suvarna Lakshmi Labh 63 kg (total 115 kg), fully hedged on MCX
Scheme sales contribute ~7-8% of annualized revenue (~INR 700 crores)
New store capex increased to INR 47-50 crores (incl. INR ~2 cr capex) due to higher gold prices
Total store count 63 at end Q2 FY26 (8 added in Q2: 5 COCO, 3 FOCO); entered Indore, Lucknow, Kanpur
H2 FY26 plan: add 14-16 stores (6-7 PNG, 7-8 LiteStyle; 50% COCO, 50% FOCO)
LiteStyle stores: 1,500-2,000 sq ft, inventory INR 8-10 cr, target 2.5-3 stock turns, gross margin 20-25%, breakeven 12-18 months
Added three new company-owned stores in Q3 FY26 at Moshi, Patna, and Viman Nagar (LiteStyle)
Total retail footprint reached 66 stores as of December 2025
Total retail area was 2,09,883 sq ft as of December 2025
Management remains focused on driving same-store sales growth, maintaining healthy inventory turns, and sustaining profitable growth
FY26 revenue projected to exceed INR 9,500 crore, close to INR 10,000 crore
FY27 revenue target of INR 11,500-12,000 crore, implying 20-25% growth over FY26
Sustainable annual EBITDA margin 7-7.25%, PAT margin 3.75-4%
Sustainable gross margin 13-14%
PNG store capex ~INR 2 crore fit-out + INR 55 crore inventory; Litestyle store capex ~INR 70 lakh fit-out + INR 8-10 crore inventory; franchise capex borne by franchisee
Plan to add 11-12 stores in Q4 FY26 to reach 78-80 stores by March 2026; target 25 stores in FY27 (50% PNG, 50% Litestyle; mix of COCO and FOCO) to reach 105 stores by March 2027
Q3 consolidated revenue INR 3,302 crore (+35.6% YoY); 9M FY26 revenue INR 7,194.8 crore; retail 76.8% of sales, e-com +125.8% YoY, franchise +65.4% YoY
Q3 gross profit +98.2% YoY to INR 474 crore; EBITDA +109.4% to INR 271.7 crore; net profit +98.6% to INR 170.9 crore (5.2% margin); 9M gross margin 13.2%, EBITDA margin 7.5%, net margin 4.4%
Retail segment sustainable EBITDA margin 8-8.25%, PAT margin ~5.5%
Capital expenditure on fixed assets including CWIP Rs 65.013 crore
All IPO commitments fulfilled; added 39 stores post-IPO
Company targets FY30 organised jewellery market share of 55% versus China 72% and USA ~95%
FY27 revenue guidance of INR13,500 crores with EBITDA margin 7-7.5% and PAT margin 4%
Retail segment FY27 target of INR9,800 crores representing 23% growth over FY26
Q4 FY26 gross margin declined 230 bps YoY to 9.7% due to higher gold bars/coins mix, lower studded ratio, and promotional discounts
Full year FY26 gross margin expanded 280 bps to 12%, EBITDA margin improved 180 bps to 6.6%, PAT margin expanded 100 bps to 3.8%
Gold bars/coins gross margin 0.5-1% vs gold jewellery 12.5-13%, franchise gross margin 2.5-3%
Total store count reached 78 as of March 31, 2026 (25 added in FY26: 12 in Q4 including 8 COCO and 4 FOCO)
Total store count reached 78 as of 30th June 2026 (57 COCO, 21 FOCO)
Total COCO store area was 199,065 sq ft as of Q1 FY27
Total FOCO store area was 38,838 sq ft as of Q1 FY27
Company targets pan-India expansion into Punjab, Haryana, Gujarat, Karnataka, Chhattisgarh, Odisha, Jharkhand, and Bihar
Company aims for FOCO-led asset-light expansion for both Legacy and LiteStyle formats
Store expansion guidance: around 25 stores to be opened in FY27, reaching ~103 stores by year-end
EBITDA margin guidance for full year FY27 at around 7%
PAT margin target for FY27 between 4.1% to 4.25% without hedging gains
PAT margin target of 4.5% to 4.7% by FY29
Other expenses guidance for FY27 at ~3% of total sales or ~INR400 crores
Hedging coverage target: 80% by Q3 FY27, 90-100% by next financial year
Current store count at 78 (57 COCO, 21 FOCO); plan to add 25 stores in FY27 reaching 103 (63 COCO, 40 FOCO)
Three-year expansion plan: 37 stores in FY28 and 37 in FY29, reaching 177 stores by March 2029 (113 legacy, 64 litestyle)
Q1 FY27 gross margin 13.2%, EBITDA margin 8% (up 80 bps YoY), PAT margin 4.4% (up 40 bps YoY)
Retail gross margin target 13-14% with current studded ratio of 10-11% and 78-79% jewellery mix
Raised INR 700 Crs through QIP completed on August 4, 2026
Completed acquisition of Silvostyle on 1st October 2026
Total store count reached 80 (59 COCO, 21 FOCO) across 6 states and USA as of 30th September 2026
Total COCO store area 207,219 sq. ft. and FOCO store area 41,634 sq. ft. as of Q2 FY27
Added 2 new stores (Amanora & Gurugram) in Q2 FY27
Expansion vision includes Pan-India store expansion, YOOU & Silvostyle sub-brand acceleration, franchise-led asset-light growth, and digital + e-commerce acceleration
FY27 revenue target INR13,000 crores plus; PAT margin 4% to 4.2%
Aspirational FY29 revenue around INR17,000 crores plus; CAGR FY27-29 ~25%
Plan to open 23 new stores in FY27, total ~103 by year-end; 8-10 in Q3, rest in Q4
FY28 onward: 50-50 COCO/FOCO split; targeting 30-35 stores/year (17-18 legacy, rest YOOU)
UP/Central India stores: stock turn ~1.1x, revenue ~INR60 crores/store, stud ratio 17.4%
Mature store target: 3.5-4x stock turn, ~INR200 crores revenue, stud ratio 22-25%
Q2 FY27 EBITDA margin 8.4% (+186 bps YoY); adjusted EBITDA margin 8.2% (excl. INR5 cr unhedged gain)
Gross margin QoQ dip 50 bps due to franchisee mix rising to 17% from 12%
Franchisee growth dilutes gross margin but improves EBITDA margin and ROCE (no store opex/capex in PNG P&L)
